confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Vientiane prices, not checked against live menus, listings, or July 2026 rates. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and hostel rates vary by season and room type and are less certain. Cocktail and wine are weaker and were set from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 3.5 times beer, wine about 5 times beer, reflecting higher import costs). FX: the 13 Oct 2026 value comes from search-result summaries attributed to rba.gov.au that I could not open directly. A 14 Oct 2026 value of 0.7002 was reported but a second search did not corroborate it, so the FX figure should be verified against the RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against lower-cost Mekong and Southeast Asian capitals, especially Phnom Penh, with price levels well below Bangkok.
